content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new to this forum and also new to [product_name]. I found this forum while looking for a suitable controller for a DC pump and received recommendations to try [product_name] with a PWM output. The motor in use is a 12V brushed DC type, powered by an H-Bridge Driver that uses PWM and direction as inputs. The direction is set, so only the PWM matters. I'm seeking support for setting up this programming, as I haven't worked with PLC systems in over two decades. Best regards, [user_name]
What frequency do you intend for the PWM signal?

analysis.insight_summary: The user is evaluating using a [company_name] [product_name] controller to operate a 12V DC pump via PWM control through an H-Bridge driver. Their main challenge lies in being unfamiliar with [product_name] and needing assistance configuring a PWM output, as they lack recent experience with PLCs. The user's request centers around guidance for setting up PWM control.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking clear instructions on how to configure a [product_name] controller to generate a PWM signal appropriate for an H-Bridge-driven DC pump application.
